questions.qtext: Consider the following statements for the design of a laced column and pickup the correct statement:

options.text: In a bolted connection, the minimum width of the lacing bar shall be three times the nominal diameter of the bolt.
The thickness of a lacing flats for a double lacing system should not be less than 1/60th of its effective length.
The angle of inclination of the lacing bar should be less than 40° with the axis of the built up column.
The lacing shall be designed for a transverse shear of 2.5% of the axial load on the column.

questions.solution:
(a, b, d)
Angle of lacing bar with asis of built up column should be 40° < θ < 70°.
